g.text: Figure 7A User Requirement Diagram — Execution and Evidence
(SysML requirement notation expressed in PlantUML; source: spec 3.0-3.2, 12.4)
text = "Enable a single RCA to complete
text = "Scan all journal entries in full;
Scope agreed with the stakeholder: clauses
As the RCA, I want the system to check every
journal entry rather than a sample, and to show
me the reasoning and the source evidence behind
each judgment it makes. If I revise the risk
assessment, completed procedures affected by the
revision should be flagged again, and no report
should be produced until the workpapers cover
every audit objective and every procedure is
disposed. Later, I would like to run several
engagements at once and to draw on litigation
Acceptance (excerpt of 12.4): blocks unless coverage is
100%, every procedure is disposed, scope_limited and
fragments referenced, exclusion registers and P0/P1
Box «requirement» = one requirement, carrying its id and text.
Crosshair line (+--) = SysML containment; the crosshair sits on the container.
Dashed arrow «deriveReqt» = the derived requirement points at its source.
Notes give the acceptance criteria from the traceability matrix (12.4).
Other requirements: Figure 7B (Member B), Figure 7C (Member C); full set in Figure 7.
